final_message:
I fixed the yen receipt bug, and all 18 tests now pass, including the yen receipt test.

The cause was in `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js`. It divided every amount by 100, so 500 yen printed as `¥5.00`. Yen has no minor unit, so I added a zero-decimal currency list (`JPY` only) and those amounts now print as whole numbers.

`formatMoney` is shared, so cart totals and invoice lines now show yen correctly too. Nothing else in the code handled JPY separately, so there was no workaround to undo. If you need other zero-decimal currencies such as KRW, add them to that list.
